title: Hackovate 2025
description: An AI/ML-powered Cattle Analytics Platform built in 36 hours. It predicts milk yield, detects cattle diseases, and provides multilingual veterinary guidance. The solution integrates XGBoost regression and classification models, explainability with SHAP, PDF report generation, and an AI chatbot specialized in cattle health.
achievement: Built and deployed a complete AI-driven cattle monitoring solution in 36 hours.

title: Odoo Hackathon 2025
description: Our team made it to the offline round of Odoo Hackathon 2025 after clearing the online round with a rank of 335 out of 2000+ registrations. We spent 24 intense hours at Gandhinagar collaborating, coding, and delivering a complete project as per the problem statement. It was a thrilling experience filled with teamwork, late-night hustle, and lots of learning.
achievement: Advanced to offline round and delivered a full solution.

title: HackNUthon 2025
description: We built a Smart Kitchen System for Petpooja that identifies food objects using Computer Vision, links to an inventory dashboard for real-time stock tracking, implements a waste management system powered by Machine Learning, and suggests recipes using the MealDB API by prioritizing ingredients nearing expiry. The project aimed to reduce food waste and optimize kitchen management with AI-driven solutions.
achievement: Built an AI-powered Smart Kitchen prototype in 3 days.

title: Economania 2025 - FinTech Hackathon
description: Prototype EV Rental Management System with KYC verification, booking flow, and responsive design. Focused mainly on frontend as our first hackathon.
achievement: First hackathon — gained confidence presenting and tackling challenges.
